dict.string: SUBQUERY(extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" AND NOT (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.file-url")) OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text" OR ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image").@count >= 1 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" AND NOT (ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.file-url"))).@count <= 1 AND SUBQUERY($item.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image").@count <= 5).@count == 1
